classes.name: APIRequestContext
classes.description: Documentation for the APIRequestContext class in Playwright, used for Web API testing, with details on methods such as get, post, delete, fetch, etc., including their parameters, return types, and usage examples.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.createFormData
methods.description: Creates a new FormData instance used for providing form and multipart data when making HTTP requests.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.delete
methods.description: Sends an HTTP DELETE request, handling cookies and redirects, returning an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.dispose
methods.description: Discards all resources associated with the APIRequestContext. Subsequent method calls will throw exceptions.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.fetch
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with customizable method, headers, payloads, and multipart data, returning an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.get
methods.description: Sends a GET request and returns an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.head
methods.description: Sends a HEAD request and returns an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.patch
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request and returns an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.post
methods.description: Sends a POST request and returns an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.put
methods.description: Sends a PUT request and returns an APIResponse.

methods.name: APIRequestContext.storageState
methods.description: Returns the storage state, including cookies and local storage, optionally including IndexedDB, as a JSON object or string depending on language.
